property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and matching v lengths, C.transfer(...) always returns true (non-reverting calls succeed and return true); the mutant returns false instead for successful executions, violating this rule for inputs where the call does not revert.

For any non-empty _tos and matching v lengths where all external calls from C to the callee succeed (do not revert), C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for successful executions, so there exist inputs (non-empty _tos with a callee that accepts the calls) where the mutant's return value differs.

For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always attempts the external calls and thus will revert if any called counterparty reverts; the mutant that returns early breaks this by never performing the calls so it cannot revert for those inputs.
